prompt: How many years had passed since the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania was admitted to the Union by the time Rep. Robert D. Heaton was born?
answer: Pennsylvania was admitted to the Union on **December 12, 1787**. Rep. Robert D. Heaton was born on **July 1, 1873**, so about **85 years and 6½ months** had passed—**86 years by calendar-year subtraction**.
